newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine trade gap little changed in October.
newsitem.headline: Argentine trade gap little changed in October.

text.p: Argentina's October trade deficit was little changed over a year earlier, with it registering at $174 million versus $175 million,the Economy Ministtry said Thursday.
The figures compared to a $70 million trade gap in September this year.
For the first 10 months of the year Argentina registered a trade surplus of $276 million, much smaller than the surplus of $1.01 billion reported a year earlier.
Exports totalled $2.08 billion in October, up 32 percent from the same month last year, while imports of $2.26 billion were 29 percent higher than October last year.

Detailing exports for the first 10 months of the year, which were up 12 percent overall, the ministry said sales of manufactured food goods were up 15 percent, primary products rose 16 percent and fuel 35 percent, while industrial exports fell 3.0 percent.
